newsitem.title: UK: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - Oct 27.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - Oct 27.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in two London-based Arabic-language newspapers on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Arabian Oil Transportation Company buys oil tanker to hire to Libya.
- Two Saudi and Kuwaiti oil companies plan to boost production to 750,000 barrels per day in area dividing Saudi Arabia and Kuwait.
- Insurance cost for fifth Arabian jewelry exhibition in Bahrain stands at $10 million.
- Egyptian Cement Company sells 20 percent of its shares to the Swiss Cement Group (Holder Bank). The company sets aside 650 million pounds to construct a new plant.
- Saudi Mininster of commerce and and U.S. ambassador discuss investment opportunities.
